Composition is critical: square canvas intended for 640 x 640 export. The square board fills almost the whole image, its straight outer edges near the canvas edges. The whole INNER 80% x 80% must be a continuous flat, clean, evenly colored grey-celadon work surface with extremely low texture. All bronze or wood trim, small corner fittings, tiny wear and decorative detail MUST stay within the outermost 10% border; do not let corner fittings invade the inner square. True alpha-transparent background outside the object; the board surface itself is solid. No paper background or black background, no checkerboard painted into the art. Do not add a hand, pedestal, floor, scene, cast shadow, haze, glow or halo.
